protocol.status: User-requested Buffett extension after inspecting earlier asset tests; frozen before these regressions, not untouched historical preregistration.

definition.reason: Fed public equity memo includes ETF and closed-end fund values; remove these components for primary domestic listed corporate equity proxy. Still includes REITs/holding companies and is not a Wilshire proprietary index.
definition.denominator: Nominal GDP, billions USD, seasonally adjusted ANNUAL RATE; do not multiply or divide by4. Quarter-end numerator vs quarterly annual-rate GDP; not original GNP version.
definition.quarter_timestamp: FRED quarter-start date is a label, remapped to the quarter end; never treated as publication date.
definition.history: Prior to1996Q4 public equity classification included closely-held in some sectors; study begins2003.

measurement.formula: S=R+P; vector=(R/S,P/S); midpoint scalar=(p0+p1)/2*(S1-S0); allocation=(S0+S1)/2*(p1-p0); preserve dollar identity. Regression units=100*contribution/initial bank assets.
measurement.quantity_date: Last COMMON Wednesday on or before quarter_end minus14calendar days, max20day gap. No imputation; full missing quarter not compressed.

models.contemporaneous: Target=100log(BI_q/BI_q-h), baseline=100*delta10Yreal yield and100*deltaEBP, augmentation=scalar/allocation same past h quarter window. Real yield uses latest valid observation<=quarterend and<=7days old; EBP exact terminal quarter month. Controls may publish later, association only.
models.leading: Decision=quarterendq; target=100log(BI_q+h/BI_q). Past hquarter quantity signal is already14days buffered. Baseline=100log(BI_q-2/BI_q-2-h), publication assumed120days after that outcome quarterend. No future real-rate or EBP controls.
models.inference: OLS intercept, HAC Bartlett4 valid quarterly lags with finite-sample correction; 2definitions x2 horizons x2timings=8joint Wald block tests Holm8. Also display Holm52 sensitivity including preserved44v3 raw p values. Era splits pre2020/post2020 descriptive only and no new significance gate.
models.forecast: Leading only, expanding same rows baseline/augmented, min40eligible samples; train target_end+120days<=decision; no fitted thresholds/winsorization. Both definitions and horizons retained. Paired stored loss circular bootstrap2000 draws block4/8quarters fixed seed20260907; not full-refit uncertainty.
models.component_attribution: 100logBIchange=100logcapchange-100logGDPchange. Same design matrix OLS component coefficients must decompose BI coefficients. Components are arithmetic diagnostics without additional p-value search.

limits: Revised current-vintage histories;14/120day availability buffers are explicit assumptions, not restored releases/vintages. No tradable portfolio/CAGR.
Stock-market capitalization/GDP is not PE and a high ratio is not intrinsic-value overvaluation.
Marketcap changes include issuance/buybacks/composition, not total investor returns. GDP contraction can increase the ratio.
Nominal capitalizations and GDP contain secular structure/global revenues; changes tests do not establish or refute long-run levels relationships.
No point-in-time expected earnings or equity-specific risk premium; EBP partial credit proxy only.
Raw public-equity sensitivity is not an independent replication; no optimization of S/p definitions to these outcomes.

metadata.title: Gross Domestic Product
metadata.notes:
BEA Account Code: A191RC

Gross domestic product (GDP), the featured measure of U.S. output, is the market value of the goods and services produced by labor and property located in the United States.For more information, see the Guide to the National Income and Product Accounts of the United States (NIPA) and the Bureau of Economic Analysis (http://www.bea.gov/national/pdf/nipaguid.pdf).
